name: Peaches the Hamster
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D SpriteKit desktop companion sprite atlas for PawSync.
Draw an exceptionally cute original kawaii desktop pet. Subject: A tiny buttery cream and apricot hamster with rounded ears, plump cheeks, shiny brown dot eyes, pink tiny nose, short mitten paws and a warm cream belly.
Style: cozy flat hand-illustrated sticker art, warm dark-brown smooth outlines, rounded soft organic shapes, solid muted pastel colors and minimal cel shading, charming affectionate face. Oversized head and small body, original mascot design, not photoreal or 3D.
Transparent-background 1536x1024 PNG. EXACT grid: 3 columns and 2 rows each512px square. Six separated cutouts centered in their cells with ample truly transparent alpha padding. No gridlines labels or text.
TOP LEFT: detached complete HEAD ONLY with ears and face. TOP CENTER: complete small squat TORSO with TWO tiny rounded hind feet naturally incorporated along its bottom, NO head and NO arms. TOP RIGHT: detached LEFT FOREPAW ONLY, a VERY SHORT round mitten with tiny wrist attachment at top, fingers pointing DOWN; no long arm and no human hand. BOTTOM LEFT: matching RIGHT FOREPAW ONLY anatomically mirrored. BOTTOM CENTER: detached TAIL ONLY base at left. BOTTOM RIGHT: full assembled same character, standing on its little feet, head oversized, paws resting naturally at its sides, sweet neutral expression.
The five detached pieces must exactly match the assembled pet. Paw silhouettes short and rounded, thumbs face inward once attached left and right. Keep each image entirely in its own cell. No keyboard, no desk, no furniture, no props, no clothing, no accessories, no watermark, no background or checkerboard. Legible at 160px.
